missing_diagrams.diagram_kind: Directed DAG route segment with a repeated vertex and collider
missing_diagrams.rationale: The loop deletion proof hinges on the first direction change along the deleted segment becoming a collider, which is then an ancestor witness. A small labeled graph can make the orientations and contradiction easier to follow.
missing_diagrams.draw_or_check: Show the repeated vertex v and deleted excursion v→…→w←…←v, with w labeled as a collider and an arrow path from w to a vertex in C. Include the retained route edges immediately before the first v and after the second v so the newly joined occurrence is visibly a collider. Mark that the graph is a DAG and that w being an ancestor of C implies v is an ancestor of C. Keep the proof itself independent of the drawing.
missing_diagrams.status: candidate only; the source is complete and the absence of a diagram is not a defect.

review_scope.method: Compared each frozen source snapshot with its matching local HTML preview; visually inspected every receipt-listed PNG tile individually at original resolution.
review_scope.source_html_and_tile_hashes: Verified against assignment and capture receipts; all matched.
review_scope.diagram_scope: No assigned snapshot contains TikZ or diagram markup. Reviewed the mathematical content for missing high-likelihood diagrams; one optional, non-defect candidate is recorded for the active-route loop-junction proof.
review_scope.limitations: Local preview audit only; no production website, network, or live application route was accessed.
review_scope.attestation: The assigned reviewer opened every listed PNG using tools.view_image at original resolution and inspected each tile individually.
